text:
Elena Gomez: Quick idea - run a 4-week "sprintlet" for 5 design partners to validate Private onboarding friction. Goal: prove we can onboard one partner end-to-end in <10 days.

Tom Rivers: sounds reasonable. fewer weeks makes it easier for partners to commit. what are the non-negotiables?

Priya Chen: non-negotiables = security approval, network connectivity, and basic observability. everything else we log as "asks". Thinking minimal gates: Week0 connect + Week2 workload.

Devon R: can you be more specific on the gates? eng needs binary checks.

Priya Chen: Gate definitions (short):
```
Gate 0 (pre-kick): NDA signed, legal checklist, partner contact identified
Gate 1 (connect): VPC/creds + sample inference call w/ logs streaming
Gate 2 (workload): 2h sustained inference run, capture latency/cost, UX survey
```

CS Liaison: recommend adding a quick partner expectation doc so partners know time commitments (1h/week + 2 short checks). reduces dropouts.

Elena Gomez: yes - we'll send a one-pager with bullets and a 3-line outreach template. keep ask short: 5 prompts, 1 test script.

Tom Rivers: on performance targets: don't promise hosted numbers. propose "target" p95 < 350ms for a 256-token canonical prompt for pilot, with a note about infra variance.

Devon R: add fallback policy to target: allow quantized/fast-variant routing if partner infra can't hit target. please record which variant used.

Priya Chen: good call. we'll record variant + applied optimizations in the tracker. Also require per-request cost tagging so we can estimate unit economics.

CS Liaison: incentives? small credit + case study offer. maybe 2 dev-hours guaranteed. partners like that.

Elena Gomez: recruiting plan: reach 12 candidates, screen 8, aim to enroll 5. outreach copy + screening questions assigned to me.

Tom Rivers: feedback loop cadence? weekly 5-min async form + one 30-min sync after Gate 2. if a gate fails, trigger 48h remediation with eng triage.

Priya Chen: prefer 24h for critical infra issues, 48 for non-critical. keep momentum. also include daily slack channel between partner eng and our eng for rapid debugging.

Devon R: please add a quick eval harness we can share (3 quality prompts + perf runner). I can package a Docker that runs locally.

Elena Gomez: Planning outline: 
```
Week-1: outreach + screening
Week0: kickoff + sandbox train (30m) + pre-kick gate
Week1: connect gate + instrumentation
Week2: integration + small run
Week3: workload run (gate 2) + collect metrics + closeout decisions
```

CS Liaison: decision authority for expand = PM + Eng + CS signoff. document any legal or security risks as blockers.

Tom Rivers: ops-bot - can you make a tracker with these gates and fields (variant, optimizations, perf, cost, legal notes)?

ops-bot: Tracker created: https://confluence.redwood.ai/sprintlet-dp-tracker. Assigned: Elena (recruit), Devon (eval harness). :white_check_mark:

Elena Gomez: I'll post outreach draft here tomorrow. one more ask: include a tiny checklist for partners to pre-install (curl, docker, basic certs) to speed Week0.

Priya Chen: will add to the one-pager. looks like consensus. tagging @Tom and @Devon for any final asks before outreach. :sparkles:
